title: HOLON result record v2 (M2, whitepaper section 8.6)
description: Superset of the frozen v1 record (schemas/result_record.schema.json). Adds the orthogonal v2 fields: per-kernel checker versions and verdict results, model hash, witness sha256, replay evidence pointer, refinement records, independence class, coverage debt, and the SPLIT status. Produced by holon.records_v2.convert; the v1 records are read, never rewritten.

statement_hash.description: IR statement hash; identity of the frozen claim

model_sha256.description: sha256 of the generated model source the claim was checked against (artifacts.model); null only when no model artifact exists

status.description: SPLIT (section 8.6): the law decomposed into proved and refuted parts; reserved, not produced by the v1->v2 converter

scope.description: unbounded = every state and trace of the closed generated model (not unbounded refinement to the real code)

bound.description: required when scope = bounded or status = UNKNOWN: what was searched

premises.description: human-readable premises; every assume clause of the law plus any oracle/cryptographic premise

independence_class.description: I2 = two independent kernels agree on the certificate (bend2 plus BendTT); I1 = single kernel

kernels.description: checker versions and verdict-kernel results, one entry per kernel that ran (or was supposed to run)

name.description: kernel identity, e.g. bend2 or bendtt (Lean-proven)

version.description: checker/toolchain version; null when the kernel never ran

law_name.description: Bend law name inside LAWS.bend (law_id lowercased, 'cl_' prefix for counter-laws)

witness.description: REFUTED only: binder name -> value (Header as field->hex, Bytes as hex, machine binders as model values)

witness_sha256.description: sha256 of the canonical-JSON witness (holon.replay.witness_sha256); binds replay evidence and G6 to this exact witness; null iff no witness

difference.description: REFUTED only: lhs and rhs values at the witness (canonical JSON form)

attempts.description: what was tried, in order (proof generators, refuter budgets)

status.description: model_only_pending_replay: the G6 escape; requires evidence=null and a detail starting with 'model-only pending replay'

report.description: path of the replay report the evidence lives in, e.g. replay/M1/report.json

entry.description: pointer inside the report, e.g. laws.L_undo_BVH

witness_sha256.description: the witness hash the report ran; must equal this record's witness_sha256

refinement.description: refinement records of the edges the law uses (section 8.6, 8.7): agreement counts on the real code

source.description: pointer to the evidence, e.g. replay/M1/report.json#refinement

edge.description: the carrier edge or action this record is about, when per-edge data exists

coverage_debt.description: coverage-debt items bounding this record's scope: elements of the target the model deliberately does not map (facts coverage.debt)

inhabitant.description: G11 evidence, when the gate has searched for it: a concrete model point where every premise is true
